## Constraints & Preferences

- Do not reopen deployment work unless a verified regression occurs (pipeline stabilized)
- Guarded pipeline: `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action, confirm:true, confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE", input:{...}}` — params under `input`; never re-commit backend/hono.ts (306KB WAF limit)
- Management API SQL: `POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb/database/query` `{"query":"..."}`; multi-statement = one transaction; ~55s timeout; token `/tmp/sbp_token`
- Owner session refresh: `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token` with `/tmp/owner_rt` → `/tmp/owner_at`; anon `/tmp/anon`; service-role `/tmp/srk`
- Local shell has NO env vars (no GITHUB_TOKEN, no EXPO_TOKEN); continue 2h executive reports to IVX AI Chat (conversation `8f5a9c42-1cb5-4f81-b2d8-6f3a0a8b9d41` via `messages` table)
